liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (1 review): Called the absolute best ever, with Jerry rocking it with passion [18]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Vocals are great all the way through, with Jerry sounding psyched [19]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Rarely a highlight, but this version feels like riding alone in the dark [17]
- **It Must Have Been The Roses** (1 review): Listener calls it one of the better versions, noting Jerry sings with real meaning [13]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Described as the best version ever, with Jerry wailing like a saxophone [13]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Jerry commands attention, ensuring the song is not a throwaway [13]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Along with Franklin's Tower, these are identified as the main highlights [21]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Squeezed into the set between Estimated Prophet and Eyes of the World [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-07-08.mtx.tobin.91777.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 192 min; rated 4.82/5 by 17 [1]
- **gd1978-07-08.dts.tobin.91875.flac**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 192 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1978-07-08.fob.knight.motb-0068.91766.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 192 min; rated 4.88/5 by 8 [4]
- **gd1978-07-08.126239.mtx-redo.eichorn.sbeok.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 187 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [5]
- **gd78-07-08.sbd.unknown.294.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 175 min; rated 4.58/5 by 73 [9]. Said about its sound: Files are mistracked, requiring filename changes to align with the correct songs; Recording quality surpasses any other heard, with lyrics very easy to understand [16][22]

## Around the show

- Crowd howls with the band during Werewolves, audible through the stage mikes [19]
- Jerry tells Donna to shush at 4:43 when she gets too loud [20]
- Considered equal to the Winterland run that closed out 1978 [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-07-08.mtx.tobin.91777.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix(40%-SBD/60%-AUD) [1]. Also: Analog audience source from Maxell cassettes, transferred via Nakamichi and Korg gear [1]
- **gd1978-07-08.dts.tobin.91875.flac**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD (shnid=294) + Audience (shnid=91766) [2]. Also: Setlist includes a run from Bertha through Werewolves of London [2]
- **gd1978-07-08.fob.knight.motb-0068.91766.flac16**: taped by Timothy Knight; transferred by Adan Egert and Kevin Tobin; source: Unknown Microphones => Unknown Tape Deck [Patch] => Nakamichi 550 [Dolby Encode] >> MAC [4]. Also: Missing audience audio between songs was filled in using soundboard source audio [4]
- **gd1978-07-08.126239.mtx-redo.eichorn.sbeok.t-flac16**: transferred by Roger Eichorn; source: 2 Source Matrix from Source 1: SBD (shnid=106070) Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Roland SRC-2 -> Dat (48k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) ->… [5]. Also: Newer release reduces audience mix, correcting previous versions that had too much AUD [5]
- **gd78-07-08.sbd.unknown.294.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jeff Hoelter; source: Soundboard [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by www.notreble.com: [Grateful Dead Set Gives Classic 1978 Show an Official Release – No Treble](https://www.notreble.com/buzz/2016/05/17/grateful-dead-set-gives-classic-1978-show-an-official-release/) [26]
- Poster by JamBase: [July 1978: The Complete Recordings](https://www.jambase.com/contest/july-1978-complete-recordings) [27]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Red Rocks Amphitheater Morrison CO 7/8/78 3 CD CD's | #4595269627](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-red-rocks-amphitheater-4595269627) [28]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 7/8/78 Red Rocks Amphitheatre, Morrison, C… | Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27268826291/) [29]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27268826291/) [30]
